description:
Redwood Inference is expanding Private and Dedicated deployments for regulated customers, so the Security & Compliance Foundation initiative “KMS integration hardening + rotation docs” focuses on making customer-managed key management (KMS/HSM-backed envelope encryption) safer, more observable, and easier to operate during normal rotation and abnormal failure modes.

Goals:
- Harden KMS integration paths across Hosted/Dedicated/Private control-plane and data-plane components (timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, caching policy, permission scoping, and safe defaults).
- Define and document a rotation procedure that is repeatable (quarterly/annual), auditable (who/what/when evidence), and automation-friendly (runbook + tooling).
- Add failure-mode testing and game-day coverage for KMS degradation/outage, permission misconfiguration, throttling, and key material mismatch (including rollback/dual-read strategies where applicable).
- Improve operator and customer-facing docs (Private deployment guides + internal runbooks) so enterprise security reviews can be satisfied without bespoke explanations.

Scope (in):
- KMS client wrapper standardization in the monorepo, with consistent telemetry (latency, error codes, throttling) and guardrails.
- Key versioning / rotation workflow for KEKs/DEKs (or equivalent), including staged rollout, verification, and rollback.
- Integration and chaos-style tests in CI/staging to validate behavior under KMS failures.
- Runbooks, standards, and decision records capturing tradeoffs (availability vs cryptographic strictness).

Scope (out):
- New cryptographic primitives (no net-new algorithm changes); the effort focuses on integration hardening and operational safety.
- Broad platform auth revamp unrelated to key management.

Primary stakeholders:
- Security Engineering: Marcus Lin (Dir), Kevin Osei, Hanae Suzuki (implementation + standards)
- Product (Security & Compliance): Naomi Feldman (requirements, enterprise expectations)
- Platform Control Plane: Ethan Park, Benji Okafor, Jordan Lee (config/policy + integration)
- SRE/Infra: Sean Gallagher, Rafael Mendes, Allison Grant (reliability signals, runbooks, on-call readiness)
- Private Deployments: Vivek Kulkarni + infra/platform counterparts (installer, operator guides)
- Docs/DevEx: Elliot Price, Kira Thompson (docs IA, customer/operator docs)

Phases & rough timeline (single quarter):
1) Discovery + inventory (week 1–2): map all KMS call sites, current rotation practices, top incidents/support themes.
2) Design + ADRs (week 2–3): decide wrapper API, caching boundaries, fallback behavior, and rotation strategy.
3) Implementation (week 3–7): ship wrapper, policy/telemetry, installer/terraform updates, and targeted refactors.
4) Testing + game day (week 6–9): add CI integration tests, staging fault injection, run a KMS outage game day.
5) Documentation + enablement (week 8–10): publish runbooks and operator guides; update security FAQ pack for Sales/SE.

Deliverables:
- Published Confluence standards/runbooks + Private deployment operator guide for KMS.
- Linear epic with tracked engineering tasks and milestones.
- A series of GitHub PRs implementing wrapper/telemetry/tests and doc-site changes.
- Slack coordination threads (implementation, incidents, rollout comms).
- Evidence-friendly artifacts (checklists, rotation logs template, game-day report) to support compliance and customer security reviews.

files.description: ADR defining a standard KMS client wrapper (timeouts/retries/backoff, error taxonomy, circuit breaker behavior, caching constraints) and the non-goals; includes alternatives considered and rationale.
ADR documenting the rotation approach (key versioning, dual-read/dual-decrypt window, cutover criteria, rollback plan) and how it differs across Hosted vs Private.
Security standard for key management: required controls, IAM scoping, logging requirements, incident handling expectations, and review checklist for new KMS call sites.
Process doc for requesting exceptions (e.g., delayed rotation, customer-imposed constraints), including required compensating controls and approval workflow (CISO/GRC).

On-call runbook for decrypt/envelope failures: symptoms, dashboards, log queries, common root causes (permissions, throttling, wrong key ID), mitigation steps, and escalation path to Security/Platform.
Infra standard outlining least-privilege IAM policies for KMS usage, per-environment roles, break-glass access, and how to rotate roles/credentials safely.
Operator-focused guide for configuring customer KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure patterns), required permissions, validation steps, and troubleshooting matrix; tailored to Private deployments.
Game day plan + after-action: injected KMS outage/throttling, expected system behavior, observed gaps, follow-up actions, and links to PRs/tickets.
Epic tracking all workstreams (wrapper, telemetry, rotation automation, docs, game day) with milestones, owners, and dependencies.
Ticket to define canonical error categories (AccessDenied, NotFound, Throttling, Timeout, InvalidCiphertext) and required metrics/tags for observability.
Engineering task to implement shared KMS wrapper, including configuration knobs and safe defaults; links to ADR-007.
Task to add circuit breaker behavior and degrade-mode policy when KMS is failing (avoid cascading failures); includes SRE review requirements.
CI/staging test plan ticket: simulated throttling/timeouts, assertions on retry budgets, latency caps, and correctness under partial failures.
Task for Security + GRC to define evidence artifacts (rotation log template, approvals, screenshots/exports) and align to SOC2/ISO narratives.
Ticket to add preflight checks in Private installer: validate key ID, permissions, region, and produce actionable errors.
SRE/Observability ticket to ship dashboards/alerts for KMS latency/error rate and to tune paging thresholds.
Execution ticket for the game day: scenario design, participants, schedule, comms plan, and a follow-up action list.
PM ticket capturing enterprise expectations for rotation cadence, evidence, and documentation deliverables needed for security reviews.
PR adding a shared KMS client abstraction in the monorepo with explicit timeouts, standardized retries, and structured error mapping.
PR instrumenting KMS calls (latency histograms, error counters by code, trace spans) and wiring to existing telemetry conventions.
PR implementing circuit breaker logic and documented degrade behavior to prevent request storms during KMS incidents; includes SRE-requested changes.
PR tightening caching semantics around key metadata/material to reduce stale reads during rotation; includes correctness notes and rollback switch.
PR introducing dual-read/dual-decrypt window support (read old+new key versions) controlled by config flags; links to ADR-008.
PR improving error messages surfaced to operators (permission missing, wrong principal, wrong key ARN) with remediation hints.
PR adding integration tests simulating KMS timeout/throttling and asserting retry budgets, latency caps, and correct failure propagation.
PR adding config validation/guardrails so overly aggressive retry settings can’t be enabled in prod without an explicit override.
PR adding inline documentation and log field conventions for KMS failures to make on-call triage consistent.
PR adding an internal healthcheck endpoint and SRE hooks used by alerting and pre-deploy checks.
PR enhancing Private installer to run KMS preflight checks, fail fast with actionable output, and generate a validation report for audits.
PR updating Terraform modules with least-privilege KMS IAM policies and role separation for rotation vs runtime decrypt.
PR adding dashboards/alerts for KMS dependency health, including recommended thresholds and per-environment panels.
Docs PR publishing the Private operator guide for KMS integration, including troubleshooting and validation steps.
Docs PR adding a rotation procedure page and an evidence checklist aligned to compliance/audit needs.
PR adding explicit audit log events for rotation-related changes (key version updates, cutover toggles) for compliance evidence.
PR updating audit log export schemas/parsers so KMS rotation events are included for customer SIEM ingestion.
Hotfix PR after a near-incident: reduces retry amplification and adds jitter; includes incident link and follow-up items.
PR adding throttle budgets/backpressure integration to avoid saturating KMS under load spikes.
Working design notes (rough) covering call sites inventory, open questions, and early sketches for wrapper API + rollout sequencing.
Spreadsheet-style doc enumerating failure modes (timeouts, throttling, AccessDenied, key disabled), expected behavior, and test coverage status.
Draft evidence template/checklist for audits: approvals, change tickets, rotation timestamps, logs, and sign-off fields.
Outline and TODO list for the operator guide (sections, screenshots needed, example configs, known pitfalls) before moving to Confluence/docs site.
Tuning notes from SRE/observability: proposed SLOs, alert thresholds, false positive analysis, and rollout plan for paging.
Customer-facing draft FAQ used by Sales/SE: rotation cadence, customer responsibilities, outage behavior, and how Redwood proves compliance.
Thread coordinating the error taxonomy, naming conventions for log fields, and review feedback from SRE and Platform.
Thread debating dual-read window design, config rollout safety, and how to avoid partial cutover states.
Thread about alert noise during rollout, proposed threshold changes, and a plan to split alerts by environment/region.
Thread reviewing least-privilege IAM scopes and whether rotation requires separate principals from runtime decrypt.
On-call coordination thread identifying missing runbook steps and collecting real error examples to include.
Incident-response thread for a KMS timeout spike: mitigations, comms, and follow-up PRs/tickets.
Architecture review thread for ADR-007: open concerns, decision points, and final approval.
Docs review thread with writer feedback, missing prerequisites, and requests for clearer troubleshooting examples.
Release thread planning staged rollout, feature flags, canary criteria, and rollback triggers.
Thread between Security/GRC and engineering about what evidence is needed and how to automate collection.
Thread brainstorming game-day scenarios (throttling vs full outage) and assigning roles (facilitator, observers, comms).
Thread deciding where to enforce validation (control plane API, installer preflight, runtime) and how to message failures to customers.
Thread coordinating Terraform module changes, version bumps, and compatibility notes for existing Private customers.
Support/Eng thread triaging a Private customer’s AccessDenied issue, sharing logs, and mapping to a Jira SUP ticket.
Thread aligning metric names/tags with Redwood observability standards; includes final naming decision.
Thread establishing rollback criteria (error rate thresholds, decrypt mismatch signals) and operational steps.
Thread about where the wrapper lives in the monorepo, API surface, and migration plan for existing call sites.
Thread doing a runbook dry-run in staging and capturing edits needed before publishing.
Thread documenting a near-miss where retries amplified load; leads to hotfix PR and follow-up action items.
Thread confirming post-rollout checklist items: dashboards green, error budgets stable, no customer tickets.
Customer support ticket: Private customer reports decrypt failures due to KMS AccessDenied; includes environment details, logs, fix/workaround, and follow-up guidance.
Ticket for intermittent 5xx correlated with KMS throttling; includes investigation notes, dashboard links, and mitigation (backoff/jitter + quota guidance).
Internal support/helpdesk ticket to provision break-glass audit access for rotation evidence gathering; includes approvals and access expiry.
Ticket from an enterprise customer asking for rotation procedure, evidence, and operator steps; references Confluence/docs pages and a Drive template.
Email thread in the CISO mailbox aligning on what evidence is required for audits, who signs off, and deadlines for publishing the template/runbook.
Email thread coordinating customer-facing materials for an enterprise security review (KMS/rotation behavior, outage handling, links to docs and FAQ).
Internal leadership thread reviewing rollout risk, mitigations, and go/no-go criteria; includes requests for SRE sign-off and staged deployment plan.
Security/compliance review call transcript with an enterprise prospect focused on KMS integration, rotation cadence, audit evidence, and failure-mode behavior; includes action items and next steps.
Technical deep dive transcript (SE-led) covering Private deployment KMS setup, IAM, installer validation, and troubleshooting common failure modes.
CRM company record for an enterprise prospect (Acme Bank) with strict security requirements (KMS, audit logging, rotation evidence). Includes activity timeline linking to Fireflies and Gmail threads.
CRM company record for a regulated healthcare prospect evaluating Private deployment; notes include KMS configuration constraints, residency requirements, and procurement blockers.
